title: BASEd Bible DApp
tagline: Bible DApp on BASE Blockchain. for those times when the market is down and you just need to pray
description:
About
The Bible on the BASE blockchain DApp. for those times when the market is down and you just need to pray. 
This project uses the open source bible api, the Base Blockchain api, the Wallet connect api, and V0.app aka Vercel ai. 

I used an AI prompt that included the links to the developer documentation of each of the open source api's on V0.app and the ai built out the website, which i then deployed. I was unable to get wallet connect to work and fully load.
